issue.title: [ARM] ping6 is not available in orchagent docker

failure.body:
#### Description

The `ping6` tool is available in amd64 build image but missing in armhf build image.

The base image doesn't explicitly install the `iputils-ping` for both amd64 and armhf, we guessing the tool might be installed as some packages' dependency in amd64 base image.

To solve the issue, we can explicitly install the package on the top of armhf base image.

#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Attach to swss docker
2. Try invoke `ping6`

#### Describe the results you received:
No command found

#### Describe the results you expected:
ping6 result

#### Output of `show version`:
N/A

#### Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):
N/A

resolution.title: [ARM] Fix issue whre the ping6 tool is missing from orchagent docker

#### How I did it

Explicitly install the `iputils-ping` which include the `ping6` tool to the orchagent docker
